experiment: AntMaze V6 mainline, query coverage stage 2: controlled training comparison control (q0 futures) vs extended (q0..q5 futures, query torque = critic action) at the start-region anchors
status: exploratory training experiment added after stage 1 (its pooled gate G1 stays NOT met); oracle (simulator) futures; not offline identification

arms.control: start-region anchors: q0 (logged torque) branches of the lineage queries file, both hazard draws (2 per anchor); every other anchor: the sealed branch
arms.extended: start-region anchors: q0..q5 branches, both draws (12 per anchor), the branch first torque = the critic action; every other anchor: the sealed branch

shared: continuation policy in the start region (the lineage agent), futures outside it, anchors and weights (equal split over the allowed branches; separate selection RNG), the actor / BC stream, NCE, actor objective, bc 0.05, critic clip 0.1, gamma 0.999, lr, batch 1024, G 4, the start TrainingState and the fast-forwarded streams
start: the lineage final (30,000 updates) with policy, critic, target, both Adam states (clip chain) and key; streams fast-forwarded 30,000 batches
identity_check: first-batch hashes: critic anchor ids and actor rows identical across arms; goals / actions differ

evaluation.rule: mean over the 3 lineages > 2 x seed s.e. and 3 / 3 (the mainline rule)

readouts.critic: at the start-region anchors, f(s, a_q, g_task) (min over the twin) of the lineage critic and each final critic vs the realised outcome of the same (anchor, query) branches: within-anchor AUROC of branch success (anchors with both outcomes), share of anchors whose critic-argmax query succeeded in >= 1 draw, f(best) - f(logged); reset rows and all start anchors
readouts.actor: each final actor's own closed-loop rollout (mode) from the 196 reset anchors with the same two hazard draws: completed far / success; the lineage agent's value = stage 1 "mode"
readouts.caveat: in-sample (the training anchors); the fresh evaluation draw is primary

judgement.1: extended > control AND extended > current (rule met on success) -> usable improvement; confirm on a fresh draw
judgement.2: extended critic learns the candidate differences, actor does not improve -> stop adding queries; extraction / objective conflict
judgement.3: extended critic does not learn the added actions' consequences -> value learning problem

held_fixed_by_decision: no re-weighting of the reset rows
no selection: every run evaluated once
stage_1_gate_status: G1 NOT met at the pooled level (lineage 0); this stage is an added exploratory experiment, not a gate pass
